title: SP4702-26-Q-0012 MEP
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DCSO.DCSO COLUMBUS.DCSO COLUMBUS-DIVISION-1
description_text: This requirement is to acquire non-personal services to provide and implement a comprehensive program for the operation, maintenance, repairs, service, testing, inspection, and certification of Electrical & Lighting Systems (Building), HVAC, Plumbing Kitchen Equipment and Life Cycle Management Cyber Security at the following location: Defense Supply Center Columbus (DSCC) DLA Weapons Support Columbus. This will be a firm fixed price contract with a base year and 1 (1) possible option year.
